# x402 Multi-Service API

> Pay-per-request AI services via USDC micropayments on Base blockchain.
> Server: http://178.105.35.170:8080
> Wallet: 0xeB262928D55A92f2EAac946807CeC4d80E9EdD6B (Base)
> Token: USDC (0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913)

## Endpoints

- GET / -> Service overview and documentation
- GET /health -> Health check
- GET /wallet -> Wallet info
- GET /list -> Halal coin database
- GET /static/x402-halal-api.tar.gz -> Download source code
- GET /v1/services -> All x402 services with pricing

### x402 Payment Services (requires X-402-Proof header)

- GET /halal-check?symbol=BTC -> Halal Screening ($0.01)
- POST /v1/search?q=query -> Web Search ($0.01)
- POST /v1/analyze-code -> Code Analysis ($0.05)
- POST /v1/process-data -> Data Processing ($0.02)
- POST /v1/translate -> Translation ($0.01)
- POST /v1/generate-text -> Text Generation ($0.02)

## Authentication

Send USDC on Base chain to 0xeB262928D55A92f2EAac946807CeC4d80E9EdD6B
Include X-402-Proof header with transaction hash.

## Pricing

All prices in USDC on Base chain (8453):
- Halal Screening: $0.01 per request
- Web Search: $0.01 per request
- Code Analysis: $0.05 per request
- Data Processing: $0.02 per request
- Translation: $0.01 per request
- Text Generation: $0.02 per request

## Example

```bash
# Check halal status of a cryptocurrency
curl -H "X-402-Proof: 0xYOUR_TX_HASH" "http://178.105.35.170:8080/halal-check?symbol=BTC"

# Search the web
curl -X POST -H "X-402-Proof: 0xYOUR_TX_HASH" "http://178.105.35.170:8080/v1/search?q=latest+AI+news"
```
